svg.desc: Layer layouts of Qwen3.5-2B (24 layers: 18 linear-attention layers with a fixed-size state, 6 full-attention layers with a growing key-value cache) and Gemma 4 E2B (35 layers: sliding-window layers with a cache capped at the window of 512 tokens, full-attention layers with a growing cache, and a per-layer embedding table read by every layer; layers 15 to 34 keep no cache and reuse the keys and values of layer 13 or 14).
